'''Pokémon Adventures RGB volume 2''' (Japanese: '''ポケットモンスターSPECIAL pbk-edition 赤緑青編 2''' ''Pocket Monsters Special Paperback Edition Red, Green & Blue Chapter volume 2'') is the second volume of an omnibus compilation of the {{MangaArc|Red, Green & Blue}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. It is authored by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and illustrated by [[Mato]].

==Major events==
* {{adv|Red}} meets {{adv|Giovanni}}.
* [[Team Rocket]] obtains all three [[legendary birds]].
* Team Rocket disbands.
* {{adv|Green}} is given a [[Pokédex]].
* Red wins the 9th Pokémon League.

==Party changes==
===Additions===
* Red's {{p|Sandshrew}} sometime between [[PS022]] and [[PS023]].
* Red's {{p|Gyarados}} "[[Gyara]]" in [[PS025]].
* Red's {{p|Aerodactyl}} "[[Aero]]" in [[PS026]].
* {{adv|Yellow}}'s {{p|Rattata}} "[[Ratty]]" in [[PS036]].

===Evolutions===
* {{adv|Blue}}'s {{p|Charmeleon}} evolves into {{TP|Blue|Charizard}} sometime between [[PS018]] and [[PS027]].
* Green's {{p|Wartortle}} "[[Blasty]]" evolves into {{p|Blastoise}} prior to [[PS030]].
* Red's {{p|Ivysaur}} "[[Saur]]" evolves into {{p|Venusaur}} in [[PS033]].

==Gym battles==
* [[Blaine]] in [[PS026]]
* [[Lt. Surge]] in [[PS030]]
* [[Koga]] in [[PS031]]
* [[Sabrina]] in [[PS033]]
* Giovanni in [[PS038]]
